answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Chartered editor manuscript log with editors standing, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 704 aliases would need 704 separate proofs, each costing about 119 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the raven here is verification, the yarrow of cost is what stops the farm, and the canyon of the record keeps every claim checkable. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
